estimated_cognitive_load.name: Structural friction risk index
estimated_cognitive_load.scale: 0-100; higher means more flagged source-structure friction, not more measured cognitive load
estimated_cognitive_load.calibration: Uncalibrated editorial weights; no population norm or validated cognitive-load units.

strengths.message: Source headings provide named entry points.
The full page has a level-one heading.
No generic link labels were detected in source text.

next_checks: Inspect rendered desktop and mobile layout, including visual density and text-graphic proximity.
Ask representative readers to find a fact and explain it; record task success separately from this index.
reports.limit: Source-only estimate; no rendered-layout, gaze, accessibility, or comprehension measurement.
